description: GTFS Real-Time sources for Belfast / Northern Ireland — Translink (via UK BODS), Transport for Ireland cross-border services, and Irish Rail

sources.name: Translink Ulsterbus
sources.provider: Translink / UK Bus Open Data Service
sources.note: Free API key required from https://data.bus-data.dft.gov.uk/account/login/ — set in token field

sources.name: Translink Metro Belfast
sources.provider: Translink / UK Bus Open Data Service
sources.note: Same BODS API key as Ulsterbus — set in token field

sources.name: Northern Ireland All Buses (BODS)
sources.coverage: All bus operators in Northern Ireland bounding box
sources.note: Alternative to per-operator feeds — covers all NI operators in one request. Disable the per-operator entries above if using this.

sources.name: Transport for Ireland Vehicle Positions
sources.coverage: Republic of Ireland + cross-border Translink services
sources.note: Free API key from https://developer.nationaltransport.ie/  — set in token field. Covers Dublin Bus, Bus Éireann, and cross-border services into NI.

sources.name: Transport for Ireland Trip Updates
sources.coverage: Republic of Ireland trip delay / cancellation data
sources.note: Same NTA API key as vehicle positions

sources.name: Transport for Ireland Rail (DART/Commuter)
sources.coverage: Dublin DART, commuter rail, Enterprise Belfast-Dublin
sources.note: Same NTA API key. Enterprise service runs Belfast-Dublin via Newry.
